description: An original, deliberately small starter list of commonly used third-party advertising and analytics hosts. This is not a complete EasyList/EasyPrivacy distribution or a malware/phishing database. Entries apply to subresources and include subdomains; first-party requests and top-level navigations are excluded.
provenance: Manually selected hostnames for this project. No third-party filter-list text is redistributed. Reference links describe established filter projects and browser rule behavior; they do not imply this list has their coverage or endorsement.
